file_stem: RWB E1 046 Template and merge field catalog as data
title: Template and merge field catalog as data
goal: Templates and merge fields as versioned data with Legal approval, so a letter change is no release
why: Every merge code must point at a known dictionary field, and only a Legal-approved template version can be used to generate a letter.
ace_note: No ACE read. merge_field rows name dictionary fields (sys_fields); E1-052 later fills them from the ACE views.

reads.note: field IDs a merge code may use

stores: ACE audit log; reference load record
rules: BR1: only an Approved version with a Legal approver is used (CTL-14)
BR2: current = highest Approved version with valid_from <= the date
BR3: withdrawn -> no current version, generation holds
BR4: merge codes must be in the catalog and their field IDs in the dictionary
risks: Only Approved version withdrawn -> generation holds (MSG-P6-003)
example: MF-2026.11: CASE_NO, CUSTOMER_NAME, POSTAL_ADDRESS, TOTAL_OUTSTANDING, NOTICE_DATE
DEMAND-MTG / TH approved by LEG-0001 on 2026-11-10 -> v2, current
